rebuttal_or_critique: I maintain my position that a shift to a neutral stance is premature. While I acknowledge the arguments regarding the positive real policy rate, the combination of a positive output gap of 0.70% and the persistent food inflation at 6.56%—compounded by the 6.0% monsoon deficit—creates a risk of inflation expectations becoming unanchored. Monetary policy must remain vigilant to ensure that the disinflationary process is durable. The current stance of withdrawal of accommodation is necessary to align liquidity with our inflation target and to manage the external spillovers from the US Fed's policy rate of 5.33%. I am open to discussing a transition to neutral only when the data confirms a sustained decline in food price volatility and a narrowing of the output gap.
